_meta.usage: Infer visual intent and design language. Do not replicate verbatim. Adapt, improve, and innovate while maintaining stylistic consistency.
_meta.copyright_note: Original design belongs to its respective owner. This profile is for creative direction only.

design_overview.archetype: Data-dense financial dashboard / market intelligence terminal
design_overview.theme_mode: Dark-first, near-black canvas with subtle elevation layers
design_overview.density: High — optimized for scanning large volumes of tabular numeric data at a glance
design_overview.personality: Calm neutral chrome that lets vivid data signals (gains/losses, sparklines) carry all the visual energy
design_overview.primary_metaphor: Live ledger / trading screen where every row is a comparable data record

color.philosophy: Neutral, desaturated dark surfaces form a quiet backdrop so that semantic data colors (positive/negative) and a single saturated brand accent become the only sources of vividness. Color is functional first, decorative last.

surface.canvas: very dark, near-black with a faint cool/blue undertone
surface.elevated_surface: slightly lighter dark gray for cards, header bars, and panels
surface.row_alt: barely-perceptible value shifts to delineate table rows without hard separators
surface.overlay_scrim: translucent dark layer for modals, dropdowns, and floating bars

border.style: Hairline, low-contrast dividers (1px) used sparingly; rely on spacing and subtle tonal shifts over heavy lines
border.tone: Dark gray slightly above surface luminance

text.primary: near-white / high-contrast neutral for key values
text.secondary: muted gray for labels, units, and supporting metadata
text.tertiary: low-emphasis gray for ticker symbols, captions, fine print

semantic.positive: saturated green for upward movement / gains
semantic.negative: saturated red for downward movement / losses
semantic.neutral_change: muted gray when delta is negligible
semantic.rule: Pair color with a directional glyph (up/down caret) so meaning survives color-blindness and small sizes

brand_accent.primary: a single bold, high-saturation accent (cool blue family) reserved for primary CTAs, active states, and key interactive affordances
brand_accent.secondary_accents: occasional warm/promotional accents (amber, teal) confined to badges, pills, and ads — never structural

data_visualization.sparklines: thin single-stroke trend lines colored by net direction (green up / red down) over transparent backgrounds
data_visualization.gauges: multi-stop gradient arc (red→amber→green) for sentiment-style meters
data_visualization.rule: Charts inherit semantic colors; no decorative palettes

color.contrast_strategy: Maintain low contrast between adjacent neutral surfaces, but high contrast between text/data and background. Let saturation — not brightness — signal interactivity.

typography.philosophy: Compact, highly legible sans-serif tuned for numeric density. Hierarchy is built through weight and color rather than dramatic size jumps.
typography.font_family: Humanist/grotesque sans-serif with strong number legibility; tabular/lining figures strongly preferred for column alignment
typography.numeric_treatment: Tabular figures so digits align vertically across rows; consistent decimal precision per column

scale.approach: Tight modular scale with small steps; most UI text lives in a narrow small-to-base range
scale.display: Reserved for section headlines and hero stat callouts
scale.body: Compact base size for table cells and labels
scale.caption: Smaller muted size for units, sub-values, and metadata stacked beneath primary values

weight.values_and_headings: medium to semibold for emphasis on numbers and nav
weight.rule: Weight + color do the hierarchy work; avoid italics and decorative styles

typography.case: Sentence case for nav and labels; uppercase confined to small ticker symbols and tiny eyebrow labels
typography.alignment: Left-align identifiers/names, right-align numeric columns for fast vertical scanning

spacing.philosophy: Dense but rhythmic. Tight vertical row heights maximize data on screen, while consistent horizontal padding keeps columns breathable and scannable.
spacing.row_density: Compact row height with vertical centering; supports a primary value with a smaller secondary value stacked beneath
spacing.section_rhythm: Generous gaps between major regions (nav, summary cards, table) relative to the tight intra-table spacing
spacing.card_padding: Comfortable internal padding on summary cards to offset the dense table region

radius.philosophy: Soft, modern, but restrained — rounded enough to feel friendly, never playful
radius.pills_and_chips: Fully rounded (capsule) for filter tags, badges, and toggles
radius.cards_and_inputs: Medium radius for cards, search field, and dropdowns

elevation.philosophy: Flat-first. Depth communicated through tonal layering rather than heavy shadows.
elevation.shadows: Minimal; subtle soft shadows only on floating elements (sticky bars, dropdowns, modals, promotional overlays)
elevation.layering: Surface luminance steps signal hierarchy (canvas < panel < elevated control)

iconography.style: Simple, geometric line/solid icons at small sizes; consistent stroke weight
iconography.asset_icons: Small circular token/identity icons aligned left of each row label
iconography.directional_glyphs: Tiny carets paired with semantic color for deltas
iconography.interactive_glyphs: Outline star/favorite, sort chevrons in column headers, info indicators
iconography.rule: Icons are utilitarian and quiet; they aid scanning, not decoration

motion.philosophy: Subtle and functional — value flashes, hover highlights, smooth dropdown transitions; nothing that distracts from live data
motion.feedback: Brief color flash on data update; row highlight on hover

global_structure: Persistent top utility/status bar with global market summary metrics
Primary horizontal navigation bar with brand mark, section links, search, and account/CTA cluster
Secondary tab/segment row for switching dataset views
Row of compact summary 'stat cards' (key indicators, mini-charts, gauges) above the main content
Dominant full-width data table as the centerpiece
Pagination + result-count footer beneath the table
Floating contextual elements (assistant prompt bar, scroll-to-top, promo overlay)

grid.container: Wide, near-full-width fluid container maximizing horizontal data real estate
grid.columns: Table-driven layout with fixed leading columns (rank, name) and right-aligned numeric columns; trailing visual column (sparkline)
grid.summary_cards: Equal-width responsive card row that collapses/scrolls on narrow viewports

alignment_rules.sticky_regions: Header/nav and column headers remain anchored while data scrolls

layout_patterns.responsiveness: Horizontal scroll for the table on small screens; chip rails and card rows scroll horizontally rather than wrap; progressive column hiding by priority

component_patterns.top_status_bar: Thin strip of global aggregate metrics in tertiary text with inline semantic deltas
component_patterns.primary_nav: Dark bar, brand mark left, text links center, search field + accent CTA + avatar right
component_patterns.segmented_tabs: Underline-style active indicator in brand accent; inactive tabs in secondary text

summary_stat_card.structure: Eyebrow label + small disclosure caret, large primary value, semantic delta, optional embedded mini-chart or gauge
summary_stat_card.treatment: Elevated surface, medium radius, comfortable padding, quiet borders

component_patterns.filter_chips: Capsule pills in a scrollable rail; selected state uses subtle fill or accent outline; leading mini-icons for categories

data_table.header_row: Sticky, muted labels with sort chevrons, right-aligned over numeric columns
data_table.row: Leading favorite star + rank, token icon + name + uppercase ticker, right-aligned price and multi-timeframe percentage deltas, market metrics, trailing sparkline
data_table.secondary_values: Smaller muted sub-value stacked beneath primary cell value (e.g. supplemental volume/supply figure)
data_table.row_interaction: Full-row hover highlight; row is the primary clickable unit
data_table.separators: Hairline dividers or tonal alternation, never heavy rules
data_table.inline_action: Small pill/ghost action button (e.g. quick CTA) within the row

component_patterns.sparkline_cell: Compact directional trend line, semantically colored, no axes or labels
component_patterns.gauge_widget: Semicircular gradient meter with a single numeric readout and a sentiment label
component_patterns.pagination: Centered numeric pager with accent-filled active page, ellipsis truncation, prev/next chevrons, paired with a result-count and page-size selector
component_patterns.search_field: Rounded dark input with leading magnifier icon and keyboard-shortcut hint affordance

buttons.primary: Solid brand-accent fill, medium radius, semibold label
buttons.secondary: Ghost/outline or quiet fill on elevated surface
buttons.pill_cta: Small capsule buttons for contextual/inline actions

component_patterns.badges: Small capsule tags (e.g. 'new', category markers) using muted or warm accent fills
component_patterns.floating_assistant_bar: Centered floating capsule input with shortcut hint, soft shadow, anchored above the fold's lower edge
component_patterns.promo_overlay: Dismissible bottom-corner card with stronger imagery — visually quarantined from the core data system
component_patterns.utility_controls: Scroll-to-top FAB, column/filter toggles rendered as quiet outlined controls

design_principles: Data is the hero: chrome stays neutral and quiet so numeric signals and trend visuals dominate attention.
Semantic color is sacred: green/red strictly encode direction and are always reinforced with directional glyphs and consistent precision.
Single accent discipline: one saturated brand color drives primary actions and active states; all other accents are confined to non-structural badges/promos.
Hierarchy via weight and color, not size: tight type scale keeps density high while emphasis comes from font weight and text tone.
Scannability first: right-aligned tabular numerics, fixed identifier columns, and full-row hit targets optimize rapid vertical comparison.
Layered flatness: depth is expressed through tonal surface steps, with shadows reserved only for truly floating elements.
Rhythmic density: ultra-compact table rows balanced by generous spacing between major page regions.
Restrained geometry: capsule pills and medium-radius cards feel modern without becoming playful.
Functional motion: subtle hovers and value flashes communicate liveness without distracting from analysis.
Quarantine promotions: marketing/promo content is visually separated so it never contaminates the trust of the data surface.
Progressive disclosure & responsiveness: secondary values stack beneath primaries, and rails/tables scroll horizontally to preserve information priority on smaller screens.
